import importlib.util, json, logging, sys
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ws_jsonlogger', 'src/pythonjsonlogger/jsonlogger.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
print(json.dumps({'module_origin': spec.origin}))
cases = []
fmt = mod.JsonFormatter('%(message)s', rename_fields={'message': 'msg'})
rec = logging.LogRecord('n', logging.ERROR, 'p', 1, 'hello', None, None)
out = json.loads(fmt.format(rec))
cases.append({'case': 'renamed_present', 'pass': out.get('msg') == 'hello', 'got': out.get('msg')})
cases.append({'case': 'original_not_duplicated', 'pass': 'message' not in out, 'got': sorted(out.keys())})
plain = json.loads(mod.JsonFormatter('%(message)s').format(logging.LogRecord('n', 20, 'p', 1, 'hi', None, None)))
cases.append({'case': 'no_rename_still_works', 'pass': plain.get('message') == 'hi'})
try:
    raise ValueError('x')
except ValueError:
    rec2 = logging.LogRecord('n', logging.ERROR, 'p', 1, 'boom', None, sys.exc_info())
fmt2 = mod.JsonFormatter('%(message)s', rename_fields={'exc_info': 'err'})
out2 = json.loads(fmt2.format(rec2))
cases.append({'case': 'exc_info_renamed', 'pass': 'err' in out2 and 'exc_info' not in out2, 'got': sorted(out2.keys())})
print(json.dumps({'cases': cases}, sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if cases and all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1)

arguments.new_string:
def add_fields(
        self,
        log_record: Dict[str, Any],
        record: logging.LogRecord,
        message_dict: Dict[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        """
        Override this method to implement custom logic for adding fields.
        """
        # Create a set to track fields that have been renamed
        renamed_fields = set()
        
        for field in self._required_fields:
            if field in self.rename_fields:
                log_record[self.rename_fields[field]] = record.__dict__.get(field)
                # Track that this field has been renamed
                renamed_fields.add(field)
            else:
                log_record[field] = record.__dict__.get(field)

        log_record.update(self.static_fields)
        log_record.update(message_dict)
        
        # Create a modified _skip_fields that includes fields we've renamed
        # to prevent them from being added again with their original names
        skip_fields = dict(self._skip_fields)
        for field in renamed_fields:
            skip_fields[field] = field
            
        merge_record_extra(
            record,
            log_record,
            reserved=skip_fields,
            rename_fields=self.rename_fields,
        )

        if self.timestamp:
            key = self.timestamp if type(self.timestamp) == str else "timestamp"
            log_record[key] = datetime.fromtimestamp(record.created, tz=timezone.utc)
